acceptance_gate: Prospective Astra Max design review, disjoint blind variants and held turns, same-budget comparison and physical learned-group controls.
completion_gate: Count every held-out rotation and class under both laws, identify support and causal use of learned membership, and release the science referee handoff.
dependency_text: Accepted finite precursor and frozen orientation-specific reader on 8 by 8 letters; earlier 400 excluded.
objective: On genuinely new 8 by 8 L/T strokes, measure whether reward selects a grouping of anonymous observed pixel patterns that transfers to completely withheld quarter-turns. Run and score both parity and not-all-equal; close at the frozen result.
status: Closed. The frozen reward-selected group reader failed held-turn recognition under parity and not-all-equal. Each scored 128/128 at familiar turns and 32/128 at held turns on the two new designs. The previous reader got 16/128 at the held turns. Independent replay passed. Scientific referee pending.
stop_rule: One frozen fit and one blind evaluation per specified arm. Stop at the result, including a failure.
title: Learn which local pixel patterns to count together
